class.name: SteeringRackData
class.brief_description: A resource that defines steering rack dynamics (P-D controller with inertia).
class.description: SteeringRackData is a [Resource] that configures the steering rack simulated inside steerable axles. The rack uses a proportional-derivative controller with inertia, damping, and friction to produce smooth steering feel.

members.member: Rotational inertia of the steering rack. Lower values make steering more responsive.
Steering damping coefficient. Higher values smooth out steering oscillations.
Coulomb friction in the rack. Higher values add mechanical resistance to steering motion.
Maximum steering angle in degrees at the wheels when speed is zero. This is reduced at high speed by the speed-sensitive steering factor.
Proportional gain of the steering rack P-D controller. Higher values make the steering snap to the target angle faster.
Derivative gain of the steering rack P-D controller. Higher values damp steering velocity.
Gain applied to self-aligning torque feedback into the steering rack. Higher values give stronger centering feel.
